captured_from: Defect fixes S3.5a made to bundled files while it rewrote them to schema 2 (named in scripts/workflow_equality_allowed.yml). Per workflow id: the paths it removed from the schema 1 release document. The migration removes a path from a stored record only where the record still holds the frozen release value there. The video-mux description gained its length rule. The ace-step output declares the FLAC its SaveAudio writer produces, not WAV.

set.value: Join a song or sound to a video. The picture and its frame rate stay the same, and the new sound replaces the old. The result is as long as the video. A longer sound is cut off when the picture ends; a shorter one ends early and the picture plays on in silence. The sound keeps its own sample rate and channels.
